behavior.name: RSN Radius Procedure
behavior.author: huitao
behavior.description: L1 FSM over the 10-phase distal-radius (volar FCR) workflow. Each phase announces itself, waits for an operator command (tool name / next / back / done), and dispatches tool requests to the L2 handover BT via the /run_handover action.

param.name: handover_timeout_sec
param.label: Handover timeout
param.hint: Timeout passed to each L2 handover episode.
